Dear Litware Ltd Accounts Team,

This email confirms the resolution of your request (Ticket C-8735):

1. **Billing Address Update:** Your billing contact has been updated to **accounts@litware.ai** for all future invoices. The outdated address (**ap-desk-d57u@litware.ai**) will no longer be used.

No further action is required on your part. Should you require additional modifications or have questions, reply to this email or contact support directly.

Best regards,
IT Operations Team
Litware AI Services
